intro κ'
obtain ⟨κ'', h⟩ := CategoryTheory.isCardinalAccessibleCategory.exists_regular_less_or_eq C κ X
rcases h with (⟨κ'', h⟩ | ⟨κ'', h⟩)
· intro f
  cases f with f' hf
  haveI : Cardinal.Regular κ'' := h
  haveI : Cardinal.Regular κ' := Fact.toProp κ'.IsRegular
  haveI : κ' ≤ κ'' := le_of_lt (lt_of_le_and_lt (le_refl κ') (lt_of_le_and_lt (le_refl κ'') (lt_trans h.2 h.1)))
  haveI : κ'' ≤ κ' := le_antisymm (le_trans h.1 h.2) h.2
  contradiction
